text:
Type: table
Name: AmazonBasics Lift-top Coffee Table, Espresso
Colors: Espresso
Materials: Wood
Coffee table with top that lifts to create a sturdy, raised work surface; ideal for a living room, family room, or office Hidden storage space beneath the lift-up top—plenty of room for a throw blanket, remote controls, board games, and more Made of sturdy wood with an Espresso finish; finished on all sides, which allows for versatile placement Open shelves below offer added storage and display space Measures 40 by 18 by 19 inches (LxWxH); weighs 39 pounds; backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
